python3 << 'EOF'
import re

with open('<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/Makefile', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

with open('/tmp/phony_resolved.txt', 'r') as f:
    resolved_phony = f.read().rstrip('\n')

# Match the conflict block: <<<<<<< HEAD\n<line1>\n=======\n<line2>\n<line3>\n>>>>>>> ...
pattern = r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n.*?\n=======\n.*?\n.*?\n>>>>>>> [^\n]+\n'
replacement = resolved_phony + '\n'
new_content = re.sub(pattern, replacement, content, count=1, flags=re.DOTALL)

with open('<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/Makefile', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

# Verify
with open('<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/Makefile', 'r') as f:
    new = f.read()
    conflicts = new.count('<<<<<<<')
    print(f"CONFLICTS_REMAINING={conflicts}")
    has_bootstrap = 'test-implement-bootstrap' in new[:2000]
    has_new = 'test-rebase-checkpoint-probe' in new[:2000]
    print(f"HAS_BOOTSTRAP={has_bootstrap}")
    print(f"HAS_NEW_TESTS={has_new}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
with open('<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/Makefile', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find the ONE conflict
start = sep = end = None
for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    stripped = line.rstrip('\n')
    if stripped.startswith('<<<<<<<'):
        start = i
    elif stripped == '=======' and start is not None and sep is None:
        sep = i
    elif stripped.startswith('>>>>>>>') and sep is not None:
        end = i
        break

# Extract HEAD (ours = upstream/main) and THEIRS (feature branch)
head_line = lines[start+1].rstrip('\n')  # upstream/main .PHONY line
theirs_line = lines[sep+1].rstrip('\n')  # feature branch .PHONY line

# Confirm both are .PHONY lines
print(f"HEAD starts with .PHONY: {head_line[:7]}")
print(f"THEIRS starts with .PHONY: {theirs_line[:7]}")

# Build resolved: use theirs (has new targets), but restore test-implement-bootstrap
# theirs already has test-implement-finalize, just needs test-implement-bootstrap before it
resolved = theirs_line.replace(
    'test-implement-finalize',
    'test-implement-bootstrap test-implement-finalize'
)

# Verify

has_new = 'test-rebase-checkpoint-probe' in resolved
print(f"Resolved has test-implement-bootstrap: {has_bootstrap}")
print(f"Resolved has test-rebase-checkpoint-probe: {has_new}")

# Write resolved file
new_lines = lines[:start] + [resolved + '\n'] + lines[end+1:]
with open('<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/Makefile', 'w') as f:

# Verify no conflicts remain
